Cheese factory operator 
As a cheese dairy operator, you are responsible for draining, pressing, and brining high-quality specialty cheeses. In addition, you are also responsible for making our dairy products, such as yogurt and quark. The role is therefore very diverse! You will be taught the cheese-making process by our best cheesemakers. The duties of a drainer involve ensuring that the curd is prepared for pressing into cheese (this is done by hand).
